SELECT
    from_unixtime(cast("date/key" as double) / 1000) as time,
    s.name,
    "host/key" host,
    cast("max_score/value" as double) max_score
FROM TABLE(
  quickwit.system.raw_query(
    "query" => 'host_uuid:IN [${sites:pipe}]',
    "qwindex" => 'anomaly-events-metrics',
    "columns" => 'date/key_as_string,date/key,host/key,max_score/value,host/value',
    "replacefromcolumns" => '',
    "hasjs" => 'true',
    "sqlversion" => '0.1',
    "start_timestamp" => '${__from:date:seconds}',
    "end_timestamp" => '${__to:date:seconds}',
    "aggs" => '[
      histogram(field=window_start, interval=${resolution_in_seconds}s, id=date),
      terms(id=host, field=host_uuid, size=${top:csv},order=id:max_score:desc),
      max(id=max_score, field=max_score)
    ]'
  )
) AS a
left join tenant.public.site s on s.id = try_cast("host/key" as uuid)
where "host/key" is not null
ORDER BY time ASC

    "pipeline" AS pipeline,
    max(cast("ratio" as double)) AS ratio
FROM TABLE(
  quickwit.system.raw_query(
    "query"            => 'pipeline:${pipeline}',
    "qwindex"          => 'anomaly-events-collective',
    "columns"          => 'date,pipeline,ratio',
    "hasjs"            => 'true',
    "sqlversion"       => '0.2',
    "start_timestamp"  => '${__from:date:seconds}',
    "end_timestamp"    => '${__to:date:seconds}',
    "aggs"             => '[
      histogram(field=window_start, interval=${resolution_in_seconds}s),
      terms(field=pipeline, size=4),
      max(field=ratio)
    ]'
  )
) AS a
WHERE "date" IS NOT NULL AND "pipeline" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "date", "pipeline"
ORDER BY time ASC
